C0266.title: The Last 100-Meter Logistics Brawl: Cainiao Stations Lose Clients to Poaching
C0266.summary: A 2018 Jiemian News report reveals that in the last-mile delivery segment, third-party pickup points like Cainiao Stations face poaching by competitors.
